name: Poor The
overview: Scripture commands just and compassionate treatment of the poor, emphasizing that their cause must not be twisted or denied, as seen in the instruction not to wrest the judgment of the poor (Exodus 23:6). God’s provision includes leaving portions of the land’s harvest and vineyards for the poor to gather, demonstrating a divine mandate to care for those in need without exploitation (Exodus 23:11; Leviticus 19:9-10). Moreover, believers are called to relieve their impoverished brethren without charging interest, reflecting a fear of God and a commitment to sustaining community life (Leviticus 25:35-36). These passages reveal that caring for the poor is not merely charitable but a sacred duty grounded in obedience to God’s law.
